flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

blocks.text:
flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP

          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

blocks.text:
flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

blocks.text:
flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain

        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt

          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

Let me check the analyze of the flutter app included my files — yes, no issues in copilot_cli_identity.

While the tests run, let me also review my cli_help edit rendering (line width consistency). The help text lines look right.

Let me also double check the `review_state.md` statement: 10 open threads, 6 with IDs + 4 no-id machine notices (never reply targets). I'll write 6 reply files + review_replies.json with 6 entries.

Wait — also check the general PR comments: the two IMPORTANT findings also appear as top-level PR comments (duplicated). The response.md covers those.

Now — one more check on thread 5: the review says "the loop's on Object fallthrough already gives it a natural home (try the next path, then the named unavailable)". I implemented exactly that with the timedOut refinement. Also verify the writer's behavior through the CLI export flow — the existing provider_export_test has a failure-path test (clipboardWrite injected returns failure) — unaffected.

And `_handleProviderExportCommand` gate: with the bound, `writeClipboardText` always resolves within ~5s per path → gate releases. ✓

Let me also think about whether `boundedPasteboardWait`'s kill leaves the drains of a killed process completing — after kill, the abandoned wait future: drains complete when the process dies (stdout/stderr close), exitCode completes with -9. The future completes normally but nobody's listening except the timeout wrapper's listener which ignores late completions (timer inactive → the listener checks timer.isActive → does nothing). BUT — hmm, one detail: `wait.timeout(...)` — the `.timeout()` wrapper itself listened; when the timer fired, `_future` completed with TimeoutException; the ORIGINAL future still has then-listener attached. When the original later completes with a VALUE, the listener runs `if (timer.isActive)` — false → nothing. No unhandled error (it's a value anyway). ✓ And for `_runWithStdin`, after boundedPasteboardWait rethrows, the loop-level `.timeout(processTimeout)`... wait — DOUBLE timeout on the default runner path: boundedPasteboardWait uses the FIXED 5s; the loop uses processTimeout (default 5s). If a caller passes a SHORTER processTimeout (tests with injected runners only — the loop's timeout applies to the `run(...)` future which for the default runner is boundedPasteboardWait's future), the loop's timer fires first, catches TimeoutException → timedOut. The inner 5s timer later fires → kills process → rethrows TimeoutException into the wrapper — already completed → swallowed. ✓ No leak: the process DOES get killed by the inner timer even when the loop abandoned it at 50ms — actually nice: kill still happens at 5s.

Hmm wait — one hole: in my writer test with an INJECTED hanging runner, no process exists — nothing to kill, purely the loop timer. ✓. In production default-runner case, inner kill at 5s. ✓.

Now, the remaining verification work:
1. Scoped tests (running).
2. Full core unit suite in background (after all edits final — they are now).
3. crap4dart check on the changed files (done — scoped numbers fine). The full-tree `crap4dart check` needs whole-suite lcov — CI's guards leg will do it; my scoped numbers match the previous rework's methodology.
4. flutter_app: boot tests done (18/18). Broader flutter suite? The gates run the full flutter test suite in CI shards. flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

flutter --version
