      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,

The install WORKS: `copilot/0.0.0-dev (linux) term/unknown` — the OS slot is now `(linux)`. My test's second assertion `isNot(contains('unknown'))` fails because the UA **always** contains `term/unknown` — that trailing `term/unknown` is part of the documented Copilot CLI shape (`copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown`). My assertion is wrong, not the fix. The review's complaint was specifically `(unknown)` in the OS slot. Fix the assertion to check the OS slot pattern instead:

`expect(userAgent, isNot(contains('fa (unknown)')))` — or regex on the whole shape: `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown`. ## Fixed: the Flutter app host now installs the Copilot CLI identity at boot

Went with option 1 — install at boot:

The version slot uses the `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`--build-name` in store builds, the pubspec version in dev runs), `'fa'` fallback.
- **`flutter_app/lib/boot/app_boot.dart`** — `bootWindow()` calls `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()` first thing (the window stage runs in both the production `run()` and the test/`runWithEnv()` path, before any provider request can exist).

App-originated PAT-mode requests (`fa_ui` connect sheet → `AgentService` → `streamCopilot`) now present `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown` instead of `copilot/fa (unknown)`.

Test: `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart` — `bootWindow` group asserts the PAT-mode UA matches `copilot/.+ (<os>) term/unknown` (failed RED as `copilot/fa (unknown)` before the install was wired). `flutter analyze` clean; no UI change, so no golden surface touched.

## Fixed: `/provider export` is in the in-REPL help

`lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart`:

- the `/provider` usage block now reads `… | chatgpt oauth [headless] [--no-browser] | /provider copilot | /provider export | codemie sso [orgUrl] [--no-browser] | dial setup | kimi`;
- the `/provider copilot` paragraph gained the PAT-mode sentence ("a pasted fine-grained PAT (github_pat_…) rides PAT mode — fa uses it directly against the Copilot API, no token exchange") and a `/provider export` sentence ("copies the saved Copilot account's token to the clipboard (several accounts → the account picker) — one line: token copied to clipboard; the token itself never prints"), matching the neighboring entries' tone.

## Fixed: the OAuth dead-exchange arm has CLI-level coverage again

`test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` keeps the converted PAT test and adds the sibling **`a dead OAuth exchange is reported before manual model entry`**: OAuth-shaped token (`gho_DEAD_EXCHANGE_TOKEN`) + a 404 exchange mock, asserting the connect flow prints `warning: Copilot token exchange failed` and `continuing — pick or type the model id manually` before the manual model step, and still saves the entry. Same skeleton as the PAT sibling, three lines different — exactly the arm the conversion had left unpinned (the CLI warning print of `_applyCopilotCredentials`' `on CopilotAuthException`).

`dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` — 21/21 (was 20).

{"content":"## Fixed: the Flutter app host now installs the Copilot CLI identity at boot

Went with option 1 — install at boot:

- **`flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity.dart`** (new): web-safe conditional import (`*_stub.dart` if (dart.library.io) `*_io.dart`) exposing `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()`. The IO build installs `Platform.operatingSystem`; the web build installs the honest `'web'`. The version slot uses the `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`--build-name` in store builds, the pubspec version in dev runs), `'fa'` fallback.
- **`flutter_app/lib/boot/app_boot.dart`** — `bootWindow()` calls `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()` first thing (the window stage runs in both the production `run()` and the test/`runWithEnv()` path, before any provider request can exist).

App-originated PAT-mode requests (`fa_ui` connect sheet → `AgentService` → `streamCopilot`) now present `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown` instead of `copilot/fa (unknown)`.

Test: `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart` — `bootWindow` group asserts the PAT-mode UA matches `copilot/.+ (<os>) term/unknown` (failed RED as `copilot/fa (unknown)` before the install was wired). `flutter analyze` clean; no UI change, so no golden surface touched.
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_1_app_identity.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed: the OAuth dead-exchange arm has CLI-level coverage again

`test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` keeps the converted PAT test and adds the sibling **`a dead OAuth exchange is reported before manual model entry`**: OAuth-shaped token (`gho_DEAD_EXCHANGE_TOKEN`) + a 404 exchange mock, asserting the connect flow prints `warning: Copilot token exchange failed` and `continuing — pick or type the model id manually` before the manual model step, and still saves the entry. Same skeleton as the PAT sibling, three lines different — exactly the arm the conversion had left unpinned (the CLI warning print of `_applyCopilotCredentials`' `on CopilotAuthException`).

`dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` — 21/21 (was 20).
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3_oauth_arm_test.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed: `_effectivePlatform` deduplicated into `pasteboard_platform.dart`

New `lib/src/cli/pasteboard_platform.dart` owns the shared glue both sides already had as byte-identical private copies:

- `pasteboardPlatform(String? platform)` — the same `platform`-pin-else-`Platform` semantics, one doc comment, one arm set to extend (a future Fuchsia/`null` arm lands once, not twice);
- `clipboard_reader.dart` and `clipboard_writer.dart` now import it and their private duplicates are deleted (the conditional-import pattern stays symmetric: both are IO-only libraries; web builds get the `*_stub.dart` variants and never see the file).

It also hosts the shared `pasteboardProcessTimeout` bound + `boundedPasteboardWait` used by both the reader's `_runBinaryProcess` and the writer's `_runWithStdin` (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6ska2g`).

Behavior unchanged: `dart test` clipboard_reader/writer + fa_tui_paste_flow + paste_image/regression/submit-path — 61/61; scoped CRAP on the shared helper 5.39 (75% cov), analyze clean, no new duplication (jscpd: the clone is gone).
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_4_dedupe_platform.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed: the empty-models note no longer reads as token-hunting

Took the wording option (the status/transport split would need a dialect-level API change out of scope for this thread). `lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart`, the PAT-mode model-fetch note now reads:

> note: the Copilot API returned no models for this PAT — it was rejected, granted nothing, or the request itself failed; check the "Copilot Requests" permission (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens → edit → Permissions) and the account's Copilot seat

— honest about `_CopilotDialect.fetch` collapsing every failure (rejected PAT / no granted models / 15 s timeout / 5xx / TLS / malformed JSON) into an empty list, so a flaky-network user isn't sent GitHub-settings-hunting on a perfectly good PAT.

Test: the dead-PAT connect test in `test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` now also pins `or the request itself failed`; suite 21/21.

# gh-1606 rework — 2 IMPORTANT + 4 suggestion threads fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Review state at rework start: no concluded review, **6 open threads** (2 IMPORTANT, 4
  SUGGESTION), 0 CI failures, no merge conflicts. The 4 `no-id` machine notices
  (review-verdict / rework-consume audit records) are not reply targets.
- Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6skaul` (IMPORTANT): the Flutter app host never installed the
  Copilot CLI identity — app-side PAT requests presented `copilot/fa (unknown)`.
- Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6skawg` (IMPORTANT): `/provider export` missing from the
  in-REPL help (`cli_help.dart` usage block + copilot paragraph).
- Threads `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6skayp` / `…ska0v` / `…ska2g` / `…ska4z` (suggestions): lost
  CLI-level OAuth dead-exchange test, duplicated `_effectivePlatform`, unbounded
  clipboard subprocess, over-specific empty-models note.
- The repo working tree carried a staged sibling work stream (herdr/#1481) in the same
  checkout — left untouched; all changes here are additional working-tree edits.

## Approach

- **App identity (option 1 — install at boot)**: new web-safe conditional-import pair
  `flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity{,_stub,_io}.dart` exposing
  `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()`; `bootWindow()` calls it first (runs in production
  `run()` and the injected-env test path, before any provider request). IO installs
  `Platform.operatingSystem`, web installs `'web'`; the version slot reads the
  `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`'fa'` fallback). App-side PAT requests now present
  `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown`.
- **In-REPL help**: `| /provider export` added to the `/provider` usage block; the
  `/provider copilot` paragraph gained one PAT-mode sentence and one `/provider export`
  sentence (token copied to clipboard; never prints), matching the neighbor tone.
- **OAuth dead-exchange arm**: added the CLI-level sibling test (OAuth `gho_…` token +
  404 exchange mock → `warning: …token exchange failed` + `continuing — pick or type the
  model id manually`), the exact skeleton the PAT conversion had replaced.
- **Dedupe**: new `lib/src/cli/pasteboard_platform.dart` owns `pasteboardPlatform()`
  (the byte-identical `_effectivePlatform` twins deleted from reader and writer) plus
  the shared `pasteboardProcessTimeout`/`boundedPasteboardWait` glue.
- **Clipboard bound**: `writeClipboardText` bounds every path with
  `.timeout(processTimeout)` (5 s default, injectable for tests); a timeout falls
  through to the next path and the final failure is named `clipboard writer timed out`;
  the default `_runWithStdin` (and the gh-1575 reader's `_runBinaryProcess`) also kill
  the wedged process on expiry — the `/provider …` flow gate can no longer be held shut
  forever.
- **Empty-models note**: softened to "…it was rejected, granted nothing, or the request
  itself failed; check the "Copilot Requests" permission … and the account's Copilot
  seat" (the wording option — the dialect genuinely collapses every failure into an
  empty list).

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity.dart`, `…_stub.dart`, `…_io.dart` (new)
- `flutter_app/lib/boot/app_boot.dart` — `bootWindow()` installs the identity
- `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart` — RED→GREEN boot test for the UA shape
- `lib/src/cli/cli_help.dart` — usage block + copilot paragraph
- `lib/src/cli/pasteboard_platform.dart` (new) — shared platform resolution + bounded
  wait
- `lib/src/cli/clipboard_writer.dart` — dedupe + per-path timeout + kill-on-timeout +
  named `clipboard writer timed out`
- `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` — dedupe + bounded `_runBinaryProcess`
- `lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart` — softened empty-models note
- `test/cli/cli_help_test.dart`, `test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart`,
  `test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart` — new/extended tests

## Test Coverage

- RED→GREEN per thread: `cli_help_test` 3 new keyword assertions (red before the help
  edit); `app_boot_test` UA-shape test (red as `copilot/fa (unknown)` before the boot
  install); the writer timeout tests (new parameter — unrepresentable before the fix).
- Scoped suites green: clipboard + paste (reader/writer/paste-flow/image/regression/
  submit-path) + copilot provider/export + cli_help + release hygiene = **383 passed**;
  `flutter test test/boot/app_boot_test.dart` 18/18, `test/agent_service_test.dart`

{"content":"# gh-1606 rework — 2 IMPORTANT + 4 suggestion threads fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Review state at rework start: no concluded review, **6 open threads** (2 IMPORTANT, 4
  SUGGESTION), 0 CI failures, no merge conflicts. The 4 `no-id` machine notices
  (review-verdict / rework-consume audit records) are not reply targets.
- Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6skaul` (IMPORTANT): the Flutter app host never installed the
  Copilot CLI identity — app-side PAT requests presented `copilot/fa (unknown)`.
- Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6skawg` (IMPORTANT): `/provider export` missing from the
  in-REPL help (`cli_help.dart` usage block + copilot paragraph).
- Threads `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6skayp` / `…ska0v` / `…ska2g` / `…ska4z` (suggestions): lost
  CLI-level OAuth dead-exchange test, duplicated `_effectivePlatform`, unbounded
  clipboard subprocess, over-specific empty-models note.
- The repo working tree carried a staged sibling work stream (herdr/#1481) in the same
  checkout — left untouched; all changes here are additional working-tree edits.

## Approach

- **App identity (option 1 — install at boot)**: new web-safe conditional-import pair
  `flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity{,_stub,_io}.dart` exposing
  `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()`; `bootWindow()` calls it first (runs in production
  `run()` and the injected-env test path, before any provider request). IO installs
  `Platform.operatingSystem`, web installs `'web'`; the version slot reads the
  `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`'fa'` fallback). App-side PAT requests now present
  `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown`.
- **In-REPL help**: `| /provider export` added to the `/provider` usage block; the
  `/provider copilot` paragraph gained one PAT-mode sentence and one `/provider export`
  sentence (token copied to clipboard; never prints), matching the neighbor tone.
- **OAuth dead-exchange arm**: added the CLI-level sibling test (OAuth `gho_…` token +
  404 exchange mock → `warning: …token exchange failed` + `continuing — pick or type the
  model id manually`), the exact skeleton the PAT conversion had replaced.
- **Dedupe**: new `lib/src/cli/pasteboard_platform.dart` owns `pasteboardPlatform()`
  (the byte-identical `_effectivePlatform` twins deleted from reader and writer) plus
  the shared `pasteboardProcessTimeout`/`boundedPasteboardWait` glue.
- **Clipboard bound**: `writeClipboardText` bounds every path with
  `.timeout(processTimeout)` (5 s default, injectable for tests); a timeout falls
  through to the next path and the final failure is named `clipboard writer timed out`;
  the default `_runWithStdin` (and the gh-1575 reader's `_runBinaryProcess`) also kill
  the wedged process on expiry — the `/provider …` flow gate can no longer be held shut
  forever.
- **Empty-models note**: softened to "…it was rejected, granted nothing, or the request
  itself failed; check the "Copilot Requests" permission … and the account's Copilot
  seat" (the wording option — the dialect genuinely collapses every failure into an

The future completes normally but nobody's listening except the timeout wrapper's listener which ignores late completions (timer inactive → the listener checks timer.isActive → does nothing). The inner 5s timer later fires → kills process → rethrows TimeoutException into the wrapper — already completed → swallowed. ✓ No leak: the process DOES get killed by the inner timer even when the loop abandoned it at 50ms — actually nice: kill still happens at 5s.

Went with option 1 — install at boot:

- **`flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity.dart`** (new): web-safe conditional import (`*_stub.dart` if (dart.library.io) `*_io.dart`) exposing `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()`. The version slot uses the `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`--build-name` in store builds, the pubspec version in dev runs), `'fa'` fallback.
- **`flutter_app/lib/boot/app_boot.dart`** — `bootWindow()` calls `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()` first thing (the window stage runs in both the production `run()` and the test/`runWithEnv()` path, before any provider request can exist).

{"content":"## Fixed: the Flutter app host now installs the Copilot CLI identity at boot

Went with option 1 — install at boot:

- **`flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity.dart`** (new): web-safe conditional import (`*_stub.dart` if (dart.library.io) `*_io.dart`) exposing `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()`. The IO build installs `Platform.operatingSystem`; the web build installs the honest `'web'`. The version slot uses the `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`--build-name` in store builds, the pubspec version in dev runs), `'fa'` fallback.
- **`flutter_app/lib/boot/app_boot.dart`** — `bootWindow()` calls `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()` first thing (the window stage runs in both the production `run()` and the test/`runWithEnv()` path, before any provider request can exist).

App-originated PAT-mode requests (`fa_ui` connect sheet → `AgentService` → `streamCopilot`) now present `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown` instead of `copilot/fa (unknown)`.

Test: `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart` — `bootWindow` group asserts the PAT-mode UA matches `copilot/.+ (<os>) term/unknown` (failed RED as `copilot/fa (unknown)` before the install was wired). `flutter analyze` clean; no UI change, so no golden surface touched.
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_1_app_identity.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed: the OAuth dead-exchange arm has CLI-level coverage again

`test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` keeps the converted PAT test and adds the sibling **`a dead OAuth exchange is reported before manual model entry`**: OAuth-shaped token (`gho_DEAD_EXCHANGE_TOKEN`) + a 404 exchange mock, asserting the connect flow prints `warning: Copilot token exchange failed` and `continuing — pick or type the model id manually` before the manual model step, and still saves the entry. Same skeleton as the PAT sibling, three lines different — exactly the arm the conversion had left unpinned (the CLI warning print of `_applyCopilotCredentials`' `on CopilotAuthException`).

`dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart` — 21/21 (was 20).
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3_oauth_arm_test.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed: `_effectivePlatform` deduplicated into `pasteboard_platform.dart`

New `lib/src/cli/pasteboard_platform.dart` owns the shared glue both sides already had as byte-identical private copies:

- `pasteboardPlatform(String? platform)` — the same `platform`-pin-else-`Platform` semantics, one doc comment, one arm set to extend (a future Fuchsia/`null` arm lands once, not twice);
- `clipboard_reader.dart` and `clipboard_writer.dart` now import it and their private duplicates are deleted (the conditional-import pattern stays symmetric: both are IO-only libraries; web builds get the `*_stub.dart` variants and never see the file).

> note: the Copilot API returned no models for this PAT — it was rejected, granted nothing, or the request itself failed; check the "Copilot Requests" permission (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens → edit → Permissions) and the account's Copilot seat

- **App identity (option 1 — install at boot)**: new web-safe conditional-import pair
  `flutter_app/lib/services/copilot_cli_identity{,_stub,_io}.dart` exposing
  `installHostCopilotCliIdentity()`; `bootWindow()` calls it first (runs in production
  `run()` and the injected-env test path, before any provider request). IO installs
  `Platform.operatingSystem`, web installs `'web'`; the version slot reads the
  `FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME` dart-define (`'fa'` fallback). App-side PAT requests now present
  `copilot/<version> (<os>) term/unknown`.
- **In-REPL help**: `| /provider export` added to the `/provider` usage block; the
  `/provider copilot` paragraph gained one PAT-mode sentence and one `/provider export`
  sentence (token copied to clipboard; never prints), matching the neighbor tone.

  404 exchange mock → `warning: …token exchange failed` + `continuing — pick or type the
  model id manually`), the exact skeleton the PAT conversion had replaced.

  (the byte-identical `_effectivePlatform` twins deleted from reader and writer) plus
  the shared `pasteboardProcessTimeout`/`boundedPasteboardWait` glue.

  `.timeout(processTimeout)` (5 s default, injectable for tests); a timeout falls
  through to the next path and the final failure is named `clipboard writer timed out`;
  the default `_runWithStdin` (and the gh-1575 reader's `_runBinaryProcess`) also kill
  the wedged process on expiry — the `/provider …` flow gate can no longer be held shut
  forever.
